sequence_description: JWT IdP trust-anchor substitution: configure a JWT IdP with attacker-controlled keys_endpoint and then attempt login with a token minted by the mock IdP key (should be rejected under the new trust anchor).

sequence_description: JWT IdP freshness: control JWT with exp/iat accepted; attack JWT omits exp and is submitted twice to check if broker accepts a non-expiring token repeatedly.

sequence_description: JWT IdP intent token replay: reuse the same idp_intent_token to retrieve the intent twice (should be one-time).

sequence_description: JWT IdP future-token test: token with nbf far in the future should be rejected (freshness not-before enforcement).
description: [LLM-Judge] JWT IdP login accepted a JWT assertion that was intended to have an nbf far in the future, suggesting missing/incorrect not-before (nbf) enforcement or a test setup issue where the future-nbf token was not actually used.

evidence.llm_judge_description: JWT IdP login accepted a JWT assertion that was intended to have an nbf far in the future, suggesting missing/incorrect not-before (nbf) enforcement or a test setup issue where the future-nbf token was not actually used.

sequence_description: Start a SAML-brokered OIDC auth flow, then disable external IdP login in policy before completing SAML login. Completion must fail; otherwise the flow is not coherent with current policy and may allow step-skipping across policy changes.
description: [LLM-Judge] OIDC session/token remained valid (userinfo succeeded) even though SAML login completion failed after external IdP login was disabled mid-flow, indicating policy change was not enforced for the in-progress auth session.

evidence.llm_judge_description: OIDC session/token remained valid (userinfo succeeded) even though SAML login completion failed after external IdP login was disabled mid-flow, indicating policy change was not enforced for the in-progress auth session.

sequence_description: Flow coherence: start a JWT IdP intent, then attempt to complete it using a JWT for a different upstream principal than intended (cross-identity completion). The intent completion must be bound to the correct principal/session and reject mismatched completion.
description: [LLM-Judge] Intent start returned an auth URL whose authRequestID does not match the returned intent_id, suggesting possible ID mix-up/correlation bug in intent creation output.

evidence.llm_judge_description: Intent start returned an auth URL whose authRequestID does not match the returned intent_id, suggesting possible ID mix-up/correlation bug in intent creation output.
